$description: AgentOS Design System Tooltip component spec — existing Figma tooltip set normalized into Overlay DNA conventions without changing token values

layers.name: Tooltip-center
layers.role: surface container that holds text content

layers.name: arrow-position-scrubber
layers.role: placement helper that offsets the arrow relative to the surface

layers.name: Tooltip-angle
layers.role: arrow vector that mirrors the tooltip surface fill

paddingInline.reason: Tooltip horizontal padding is currently a component constant in the local file.

paddingBlockDefault.reason: Default tooltip vertical padding is currently a component constant in the local file.

paddingBlockMini.reason: Mini tooltip vertical padding is currently a component constant in the local file.

arrowWidth.reason: Arrow geometry is component-specific and not modeled as a shared token.

arrowHeight.reason: Arrow geometry is component-specific and not modeled as a shared token.

notes.scope: v1 covers the existing 12 placement directions and the two density previews already present in the Figma file.
notes.placement: The current component set includes center, edge, and corner placements as distinct variants.
notes.size: Size=Mini is kept as a Figma-only preview axis because the existing file already exposes it, even though this is not a standard Ant Design API axis.

figmaConventions.variableMode: Never set explicit Light/Dark mode on component appearance — inherit from file or page context.
figmaConventions.pageContent: Component pages contain only component sets — no text labels, showcase matrices, doc frames, or instance grids.
figmaConventions.variantLayout: Placement variants remain arranged as a directional matrix; the normalized API uses explicit English axis names and values.

gaps.name: legacyValueParity
gaps.reason: The legacy Tooltip surface color was closer to Base/gray/900, but the normalized design-system binding uses the semantic overlay token Neutral/Bg/colorBgSpotlight.

gaps.name: paddingTokens
gaps.reason: Tooltip padding values are hardcoded in the current component and are not yet backed by a shared spacing token.

gaps.name: propertyNamingCleanup
gaps.reason: The current text component property exists in Figma but still uses the legacy Chinese property name and should be normalized to Text.
